pair.title: Pair this phone
pair.noLink: On your desktop, open Yuzora Settings → Companion and scan the pairing QR code with this phone's camera.
pair.toLogin: Already paired? Sign in with a passkey
pair.labelHint: The desktop shows this name when it asks you to approve the pairing.

labelProblem.too-long: The name is too long (80 bytes at most).
labelProblem.edge-space: Remove the spaces at the start or end.
labelProblem.hidden-character: The name contains a hidden or control character. Retype it without them.

pair.sasHint: Make sure the desktop shows the same six digits, then approve there.
pair.waiting: Waiting for the desktop to approve…

failure.invalid-link: This pairing link is incomplete or damaged.
failure.voided: This pairing is no longer valid.
failure.sas-mismatch: The pairing code did not match. Someone else may have this link, so it was not used.
failure.register-failed: The passkey could not be registered.
failure.policy-expired: Companion is off on the desktop, or its time window has ended.

pair.rescan: Create a new pairing QR code on the desktop and scan it again.

passkey.cancelled: The passkey request was cancelled or timed out.
passkey.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkey.exists: This authenticator is already registered for this phone.
passkey.security: The browser refused passkeys for this address.

login.title: Sign in
login.hint: Use the passkey you created when you paired this phone.
login.rejected: This passkey can't sign in. The phone may have been removed on the desktop.

reason.expired: Your sign-in ended. Sign in again.
reason.registered: Passkey created. Sign in to continue.

errors.policyExpired: Companion is off on the desktop, or its time window has ended.
errors.network: Can't reach the desktop. Check Tailscale on both devices.
errors.loginEnded: Your sign-in ended. Sign in again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unavailable: The desktop could not handle the request. Try again shortly.

rpc.busy: The desktop is busy. Try again shortly.
rpc.session-not-allowed: This session is not shared with this phone.
rpc.geometry-unavailable: The pane's size is not available yet.
rpc.payload-too-large: Too much data to show on the phone.
rpc.herdr-unavailable: HERDR is not responding on the desktop.
rpc.herdr-environment: HERDR could not start on the desktop.
rpc.stream-limit: Too many open views. Close one and try again.
rpc.rate-limited: Slow down: too many requests in a second.
rpc.outcome-unknown: The connection dropped before the desktop answered. Check the pane before sending again.
rpc.input-dropped: Not sent: the input was dropped before it reached the pane.
rpc.input-outcome-unknown: Unknown whether the input reached the pane. Check the pane before sending again.
rpc.write-dropped: Not sent: the request was dropped before it reached the pane.
rpc.write-outcome-unknown: Unknown whether the request reached the pane. Check the pane before sending again.
rpc.elevation-required: Confirm with your passkey to control this pane.
rpc.fresh-elevation-required: Confirm with your passkey again to take over.
rpc.scope-not-granted: This phone is not allowed to control panes. Grant it on the desktop.
rpc.taken-over: Another device took over this pane.
rpc.audit-unavailable: The desktop can't record this action right now, so it was not sent.
rpc.slow-consumer: The view fell behind and was closed.
rpc.full-limit: Another full session is already open.
rpc.agent-blocked: The agent is waiting for interactive input and can't take a new prompt. Answer with the keys or direct control.

home.noSessions: No HERDR sessions are running on the desktop.

update.ready: A new version of Yuzora Companion is ready.

control.title: Control
control.takeHint: Confirm with your passkey to send prompts and keys. Every action is recorded on the desktop.
control.elevateBody: For a limited time, this phone can send text and keys to agents on this desktop. Every action is recorded on the desktop.
control.elevateRejected: The passkey was not accepted for control.
control.hardwareKeyRequired: Control needs a hardware security key. This phone's passkey can sync (iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager…), and Companion only lets synced passkeys view. To control panes, pair this phone again with a hardware security key.
control.directTitle: Take direct control of this pane
control.directBody: Direct control attaches to this pane. The desktop pane may reflow, and its size is not restored when you release it.
control.takeoverBody: Another device or the desktop is controlling this pane. The desktop is notified if you take over. Confirm with your passkey again.
control.tooLong: Too long to send at once ({{bytes}} bytes at most).
control.approveTitle: The agent is waiting for approval
control.approveBody: Check what the agent is asking on the screen below before you answer.
control.approveNoCwd: Companion does not share the working directory. Judge from the screen.
control.blockedHint: The agent is waiting for interactive input. Answer with the keys above, or use direct control to type.
